title: Lead product designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead product designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Who are we?
Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong. Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders. Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; Java Script a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Data entry specialist
description: Confira esta oportunidade para Data entry specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor. Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance. Company Overview Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes. Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you'll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise. Position Overview We're looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect. Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply. What You'll Do Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements; Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution; Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld; Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity. Who You Are A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration. Available 40 hours per week during U. S. business hours (EST). Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets. Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly. Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up. Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight. Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus. Why Join Jones Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class Saa S growth month-over-month. Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses; Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth. Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment. Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision. Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world Develop a strong understanding of Saa S operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company. Our culture Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following: Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it's in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own. Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company. Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business. Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team's mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Business analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Our purpose eco Portal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team's potential. Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we're committed to helping clients achieve that. Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all. Who are we? We're a true Kiwi tech success story, built from the ground up, with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it. We're anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from within—with our very own team. Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole. You can see more about our storyjourney here!
We create intuitive health and safety software that people want to use, giving businesses the visibility and data they need to prevent risks and build stronger, safer workplaces and safety cultures. Safety isn't just a department, it's a culture that involves everyone, from frontline workers to the boardroom. eco Portal makes safety simple, visible, and shared, with an intuitive interface that people actually want to use. We help create stronger engagement, fewer incidents, and measurable improvements that drive both culture and performance. The Role An exciting opportunity is available at eco Portal. We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our Project Management Office (PMO) Team, supporting the successful implementation of our Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance Saa S platform. You'll play a vital role in gathering, analysing, and finalising customer requirements, ensuring that each solution is tailored to deliver value while aligning with eco Portal's product capabilities and delivery standards. As a Business Analyst , you'll collaborate closely with Project Managers, Implementation Specialists , and customer stakeholders to design fit-for-purpose solutions—ranging from minimal changes to standard templates through to complex, bespoke configurations. You'll need strong communication, analytical, and documentation skills, and an ability to work across technical and business teams to ensure clarity, alignment, and successful delivery. Key Responsibilities Lead customer workshops and meetings to capture, validate, and finalise business requirements in line with scope. Translate customer needs into clear, technically aligned documentation using tools such as process flows, user stories, and functional specifications. Support the design of both standard and custom solutions that align with eco Portal platform capabilities. Collaborate with internal teams (Project Managers, Implementation Specialists) to ensure smooth solution delivery. Proactively identify and flag risks or misalignments early, recommending alternative solutions where appropriate. Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating builds against requirements and assisting with defect triage. Contribute to a smooth customer transition from implementation to business-as-usual (BAU) through handover documentation. Maintain a deep understanding of eco Portal's platform functionality to provide practical, value-driven guidance. Assist with continuous improvement initiatives, helping to refine our BA tools, templates, and methodologies. We're Looking for Someone Who... Has 2+ years of Business Analyst experience , ideally within Saa S or software implementation environments. Demonstrates strong requirement gathering, analysis, and solution design capabilities. Can confidently facilitate workshops and work directly with customers and internal teams to define the "what" and the "why." Is proficient in documentation practices , including process mapping, user stories, functional specs, and change logs. Understands the value of collaboration and can work fluidly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Has exposure to project delivery methodologies such as Agile or Hybrid models. Communicates clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing. Is naturally curious and detail-oriented , with a drive to understand how things work and improve them. Has experience or familiarity with Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance (HSRC) systems – a bonus, but not required! Holds relevant certifications in Business Analysis (e.g., CBAP, CCBA ) or has equivalent experience – highly desirable. Perks & Benefits: 37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team. Generous Annual Leave Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with eco Portal. End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at eco Portal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you've been with e P, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you're here. ️ Professional Development: eco Portal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training. Wellness Support: To support your mental health and overall wellbeing, we offer reimbursements for professional mental health assistance. Workplace Enjoyment: We believe in fostering a positive, engaged, and diverse team through various social activities. Enjoy virtual social events and company-wide activations with the eco Portal HQ team in NZ and our global offshore team. What now? Ready to introduce yourself? Don't be shy! We want to hear from you. Please upload your resume, cover letter, and any other information, documents and links that will help you stand out. Find out more about eco Portal visit. eco Portal is an equal opportunity employer.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese language specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Position Overview: As a Gen AI Data Annotation Analyst, you will play a critical role in developing high-quality datasets that power the next generation of Large Language Models (LLMs). You will evaluate, generate, and refine multi-modal data (text, image, or video) to ensure AI outputs are accurate, safe, and culturally resonant for the Portuguese market.
Key Responsibilities Multi-Modal Annotation:
Label and categorize high-quality training data across text, image, and video formats with surgical precision. Content Generation:
Draft grammatically flawless, creative, and factually accurate text in both Portuguese and English, adapting tone and style for specific project needs. Edge-Case Resolution:
Apply logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous data scenarios where guidelines may not explicitly cover a specific nuance. Continuous Feedback:
Identify and report bugs within internal annotation tools and suggest workflow optimizations. Cross-Functional Sync:
Collaborate with Leads and Project Managers to calibrate on quality benchmarks and project pivots. System Requirements (Mandatory): Full set of desktop/Laptop with Windows 11 Pro. Stable Internet connection, which should have a speed of up to 40 MBPS
Requirements: Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification. Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects. Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms. Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context. Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments. Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training. Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content. Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles.
What We Offer: An innovative and supportive global working environment. Opportunities for continuous learning and growth. Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements. Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology.

title: Data entry specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data entry specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.
Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance. Company Overview Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes. Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you'll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise. Position Overview We're looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect. Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply. What You'll Do Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements; Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution; Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld; Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity. Who You Are A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration. Available 40 hours per week during U. S. business hours (EST). Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets. Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly. Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up. Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight. Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus. Why Join Jones Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class Saa S growth month-over-month. Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses; Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth. Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment. Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision. Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world Develop a strong understanding of Saa S operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company. Our culture Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following: Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it's in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own. Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company. Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business. Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team's mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Project manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2 B technology.
This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.
About Ten16 Creative Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3 D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.
We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.
About the Role The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.
This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.
You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.
You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.
You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.
Qualifications The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.

why

It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir ies. 6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. title: Project manager #1008790
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project manager #1008790 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Quem Somos A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.
Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.
O que esperar de nós Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?
Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.
Nosso Cliente Estamos em busca de um profissional em projetos de TI que deverá impulsionar a excelência na execução dos projetos, manter o controle sobre escopo, cronograma e orçamento, além de assegurar entregas de alta qualidade em todas as frentes. Esta função será responsável por supervisionar a entrega ponta a ponta
de quatro novos mód ulos voltados ao suporte das capacidades de Compras (Procurement), garantindo o alinhamento entre as áreas de negócio, equipes de TI e uma organização terceirizada de desenvolvimento. O candidato selecionado fará parte de
um projeto global em uma empresa multinacional do setor de eletrodomést i cos.
O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:
Gestão do Programa e Supervisão das Entregas (Program & Delivery Oversight) Será responsável pela entrega geral do roadmap dos módulos do Supplier Portal (4 subprojetos), gerenciando cronograma, orçamento, escopo e acompanhamento de marcos (milestones) em nível de programa. Também deverá manter controle rigoroso sobre a definição de escopo, gestão de mudanças e dependências entre projetos e sistemas, além de supervisionar o desempenho do Delivery Manager e da equipe terceirizada para garantir o cumprimento dos compromissos.
Governança e Comitês Executivos (Governance & Steering) Será responsável por definir e conduzir a estrutura de governança do projeto, liderando reuniões de Comitê Executivo (Steer Co), incluindo reporte de status, gestão de riscos e escalonamentos, além dos fóruns de tomada de decisão. Também deverá fornecer visibilidade e relatórios em nível executivo, assegurando transparência sobre o andamento do programa.
Gestão de Stakeholders e Alinhamento com o Negócio (Stakeholder & Business Alignment) Será responsável pelo relacionamento com stakeholders da área de Compras (Procurement) e com a liderança sênior, garantindo que os requisitos de negócio sejam claramente definidos, aprovados e priorizados. Deverá promover o alinhamento entre a área de Negócios (Procurement), as equipes de TI (MDR, PLM e Integração) e a organização responsável pela entrega, atuando ainda como ponto final de escalonamento para conflitos ou ambiguidades relacionadas ao negócio.
Gestão de Riscos e Problemas (Risk & Issue Management) Deverá identificar proativamente riscos e dependências em nível de programa, garantindo que sejam mitigados de forma antecipada e sistemática. Também será responsável por escalar questões críticas com recomendações claras e análise de impacto.
Controle Financeiro e Planejamento (Financial & Planning Control) Será responsável pelo acompanhamento e previsão orçamentária, garantindo que as entregas permaneçam dentro dos limites financeiros aprovados. Também deverá validar a alocação de recursos em conjunto com o Delivery Manager.
Liderança e Direcionamento (Leadership & Direction) Deverá fornecer direcionamento claro e definição de prioridades ao Delivery Manager, garantindo foco em resultados, cumprimento de prazos e geração de valor para o negócio. Espera-se uma atuação proativa na resolução de ambiguidades e na remoção de impedimentos para acelerar a tomada de decisões e o progresso do programa.
O que você precisa ter:
Inglê s - Avançado (necessário para Experiência como Gerente de Projetos de TI em ambientes complexos e com múltiplas frentes de trabalho simultâneas. Experiência com metodologias ágeis de entrega (Agile). Capacidade de gerenciar equipes de desenvolvimento terceirizadas. Excelentes habilidades de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação. Forte capacidade de organização e definição de prioridades. Habilidade para atuar como ponte entre as necessidades do negócio e a entrega técnica. Perfil altamente proativo e orientado à solução de problemas. Elevada atenção aos detalhes, mantendo ao mesmo tempo uma visão estratégica e abrangente do projeto. Identificar e mitigar riscos de forma antecipada, reduzindo impactos ao programa. Entregar soluções escaláveis e de alta qualidade, alinhadas à estratégia da plataforma Supplier Portal.

title: Vexos platform manager (remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vexos platform manager (remote) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. We're Hiring | VEXOS Platform Manager Remote · Full-Time | Based in Brazil
The Render Pros is the presales creative engine behind some of the most ambitious real estate developments in the world. We build photorealistic visualizations, immersive digital experiences, and VEXOS — our proprietary presales platform that transforms how developers market and sell high-value assets before they're built.
We're growing and we need a sharp, reliable operator to help us run VEXOS smoothly.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
About The Render Pros / VEXOS
We are a vertically integrated presales studio. Our clients are real estate developers, luxury asset companies, and investment groups working on projects across the Western hemisphere. VEXOS is our platform product — a fully branded, data-driven presales environment that combines 3 D visualization, buyer engagement tools, and lead intelligence. We define the strategy. You help us execute it.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
The Role
The VEXOS Platform Manager supports the delivery and day-to-day management of VEXOS client deployments. You will work closely with our Visualization PMs, development team, and founder to keep projects on track and clients well-supported.
You are organized, communicative, and detail-oriented. You follow process, flag issues early, and represent the platform professionally to clients. You execute the vision — you don't set it.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✅ What You'll Be Responsible For
• Coordinating VEXOS project timelines alongside the Visualization PM • Scheduling and running client onboarding and training calls using provided materials • Managing client communication after delivery — answering questions, logging change requests, and escalating issues to the right internal person • Keeping project trackers, onboarding checklists, and documentation up to date • Following established delivery SOPs and flagging when something is off-track • Supporting the creation of training materials, guides, and client-facing documentation as directed • Being the day-to-day client contact for active VEXOS accounts
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
What We're Looking For
Experience • 2–4 years in a client-facing coordination, account support, or digital project management role • Experience working with Saa S platforms, creative tech, or digital products is a plus • Background in real estate or luxury industries is a bonus, not a requirement
Skills • Exceptional written and spoken English — you will be communicating with US-based executive clients daily • Comfortable learning and navigating new software platforms quickly • Able to explain digital tools clearly to non-technical users • Highly organized with strong attention to detail • Responsive, professional, and calm under pressure • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift
Mindset • You follow through. Every time. • You communicate proactively — you don't go quiet when things get complicated • You take pride in representing a premium brand to premium clients • You're here to execute at a high level and grow with the company
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Tools You'll Work With
VEXOS platform (proprietary) · Notion or Asana · Zoom · Google Workspace · Loom
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
What We Offer
• Competitive salary in USD • 100% remote — work from Brazil or Mexico • Direct day-to-day collaboration with the founder • A stable, long-term role in a growing company • Opportunity to grow into greater responsibility as VEXOS scales
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
How to Apply
Send your CV and a short Loom video (2–3 minutes) covering: 1. Who you are and what you've managed 2. Why this role interests you 3. One example of how you handled a difficult client situation
Applications without the Loom video will not be reviewed.

title: Salesperson
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesperson em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Overview Full Spectrum Search Group is a national healthcare recruiting firm focused on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice. We are hiring a Recruiter to execute on active searches and drive candidate engagement across our client portfolio. This role is responsible for identifying, engaging, and advancing top talent through the interview process. This is a phone-first, outbound recruiting role. Success in this position is driven by the ability to engage
passive candidates
and turn initial outreach into meaningful conversations. If you are competitive, relationship-driven, and motivated by results, this role is for you. About the Role This role sits at the core of our recruiting execution. You will partner with leadership and work closely with the operations and research team to identify and engage candidates for active searches. This is a production-driven role. Your success is measured by activity, candidate quality, and your ability to move candidates through the hiring process. There is a steep but rewarding learning curve. You will be expected to quickly learn both our recruiting process and the nuances of the post-acute healthcare industry, including terminology, roles, and market dynamics. Professional development is a core part of this role. The individuals who succeed here are those who actively invest in learning, improving, and refining their craft. Candidate Sourcing and Outreach Proactively identify and engage
passive candidates
through outbound calling, Linked In, CRM databases, referrals, and targeted call sheets Prioritize
phone-based outreach
as the primary method of engagement, including calling candidates at their place of work when appropriate Utilize call lists and target data provided by the research team to execute structured outreach campaigns Supplement outreach with Linked In messaging, email, and text to increase response rates Manage and respond to inbound candidates (Indeed, Linked In, referrals), while maintaining a primary focus on outbound recruiting Candidate Qualification and Assessment Conduct high-quality screening calls with both outbound (passive) and inbound candidates Ask targeted, thoughtful questions to uncover experience, motivations, and openness to new opportunities Present opportunities in a clear, compelling way that resonates with passive candidates Accurately document candidate details including compensation expectations, timing, and potential barriers Pipeline Management and Execution Build and maintain a pipeline primarily driven by
passive candidate outreach , not just inbound applicants Manage multiple active searches simultaneously while maintaining organization and momentum Ensure candidates are consistently moving through the process without delays Prepare candidates for client interviews, including expectations, positioning, and feedback Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Crelate and related systems Client and Team Collaboration Partner with leadership to align on candidate profiles and search priorities Communicate candidate updates, challenges, and market feedback in a timely manner Work closely with the operations and research team to ensure strong execution across all searches Contribute to team discussions around search strategy, candidate quality, and market trends Performance Expectations Maintain
consistent daily call volume
with a strong emphasis on outbound phone activity Demonstrate the ability to engage and convert
passive candidates into active conversations Build a steady pipeline of qualified candidates sourced through outbound efforts Deliver a consistent number of qualified candidate presentations per week Maintain strong follow-up and response times with candidates and internal team members What You’ll Bring Strong verbal and written communication skills suitable for professional U. S. business communication Understanding of American business culture, communication style, and professional expectations Comfort with high-volume outreach and phone-based recruiting Ability to build rapport quickly and maintain relationships with candidates Strong organization and time management skills Competitive, driven mindset with a desire to be successful Positive attitude and ability to keep pace with a fast-moving, high-performing team Strong technical proficiency and comfort learning new tools and systems Professional home office setup suitable for business calls Reliable high-speed internet and availability during U. S. business hours (Central Time) What Separates Top Recruiters You are comfortable calling candidates who are not actively looking and earning their interest You default to picking up the phone instead of relying solely on messages or applications You know how to turn a cold call into a meaningful career conversation You actively invest time in learning the industry, terminology, and roles you recruit for You generate your own pipeline rather than relying on inbound flow You maintain persistence and follow-through without being transactional Ideal Background Experience in recruiting, sales, or other high-activity, performance-driven roles Experience with outbound calling, business development, or candidate sourcing Familiarity with healthcare or executive recruiting is a plus, but not required Track record of meeting or exceeding performance expectations Compensation and Logistics Competitive monthly salary plus performance-based commission Full-time remote position Central Time schedule Performance-based growth opportunities

title: Senior procurement specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior procurement specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Position Overview
This is not a traditional purchasing role. We are looking for a procurement leader capable of building strategic relationships with manufacturers, distributors, fabricators, and suppliers across the building envelope industry. The ideal candidate understands construction procurement, supply chain management, sourcing strategies, and supplier negotiations within industries such as: Architectural Glass & Glazing Curtain Wall Systems Metal Fabrication ACM & Metal Panel Systems Building Envelope Products Insulation Systems Waterproofing & Air Barrier Systems Fasteners & Specialty Construction Products This individual will play a direct role in improving project profitability, strengthening supplier partnerships, and creating scalable procurement processes to support Longarone's next phase of growth.

Develop and execute Longarone's procurement strategy. Negotiate national and international supplier agreements. Establish long-term strategic partnerships with manufacturers and distributors. Lead sourcing initiatives focused on cost reduction and supply chain optimization. Collaborate with Estimators and Project Managers during budgeting and project planning. Evaluate new suppliers, products, technologies, and market opportunities. Monitor commodity pricing trends and market fluctuations. Manage procurement forecasting and material planning. Improve procurement systems, reporting, and purchasing controls. Coordinate material purchasing, logistics, and delivery schedules. Present monthly procurement performance reports to executive leadership.
Desired Background Required
7+ years of procurement, purchasing, sourcing, or supply chain experience. Experience within construction, glazing, architectural glass, façade systems, building envelope, metal fabrication, or related industries. Strong contract negotiation and supplier management experience. Proven track record of generating measurable cost savings. Ability to analyze pricing structures and supplier performance. Fluent English communication skills.
Highly Preferred
Existing relationships with manufacturers and distributors in the façade, glazing, curtain wall, or architectural metals sectors. Experience purchasing materials for commercial construction projects. Knowledge of Passive House, high-performance building systems, and modern façade technologies. Experience with ERP and procurement management software.
Success Metrics
Procurement Savings Cost Avoidance Supplier Reliability Lead Time Reduction Margin Improvement Forecast Accuracy Supply Chain Stability
Compensation Competitive Base Salary + Performance Bonus The selected candidate will participate in a Procurement Savings Incentive Program tied directly to measurable value creation through: Supplier negotiations Strategic sourcing Cost reductions Supply chain improvements Margin enhancement initiatives Top performers will have significant earning potential tied to their impact on company profitability.
Why Join Longarone?
Fully Remote Position Direct Access to Executive Leadership High Growth Environment Opportunity to Build a World-Class Procurement Department Performance-Based Compensation Work on Landmark Building Envelope Projects Throughout the Northeast U. S.

description:

Our client helps organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a
Senior Solution Architect , you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization.
Why Join the Solution Architect Team? Work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms. Help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across our client’s environments. Collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success teams to shape best practices and improve the platform. In This Role, You Will Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for our client’s deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues. Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations. Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments. Partner with customer Application Developers, Dev Ops engineers, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities. Lead enablement initiatives for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.
What You’ve Accomplished So Far 5+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles, including previous experience as a Solution Architect. Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/Cent OS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS and GKE. Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix. Advanced working knowledge of Mongo DB or other No SQL databases, including query optimization and troubleshooting. Intermediate SQL skills, with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries. Proficiency in scripting and programming using Bash, Python, Java Script, and CSS. Experience with load-testing tools such as K6 and modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, Big Query) is a plus. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
How You’ll Ramp Up By Day 30 Build a strong understanding of our client’s architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes. By Day 60 Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities. Troubleshoot escalations and support customer architecture reviews. By Day 90 Own complex technical engagements end-to-end. Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.
Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se!
Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:
O Grupo Capital:
Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.
Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.
Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil.
Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.
Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita
l:
A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.
Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.
Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.
Responsabilidades:
Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas; Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço; Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente; Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas; Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos; Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes.
Pré-requisitos:
Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre; Proatividade orientada a resultados; Interesse em receber e dar feedback; Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia; Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos; Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.
Diferencial:
Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.
Você terá:
Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos; Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual; Programa de
partnership
estruturado; Treinamentos exclusivos; Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada; Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras; Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados; Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica; Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital; Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador; Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.
Modo de contratação:
Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital

title: English teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English teacher em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.
Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

description:

This is not a traditional purchasing role. We are looking for a procurement leader capable of building strategic relationships with manufacturers, distributors, fabricators, and suppliers across the building envelope industry. The ideal candidate understands construction procurement, supply chain management, sourcing strategies, and supplier negotiations within industries such as: Architectural Glass & Glazing Curtain Wall Systems Metal Fabrication ACM & Metal Panel Systems Building Envelope Products Insulation Systems Waterproofing & Air Barrier Systems Fasteners & Specialty Construction Products This individual will play a direct role in improving project profitability, strengthening supplier partnerships, and creating scalable procurement processes to support Longarone's next phase of growth.

Develop and execute Longarone's procurement strategy. Negotiate national and international supplier agreements. Establish long-term strategic partnerships with manufacturers and distributors. Lead sourcing initiatives focused on cost reduction and supply chain optimization. Collaborate with Estimators and Project Managers during budgeting and project planning. Evaluate new suppliers, products, technologies, and market opportunities. Monitor commodity pricing trends and market fluctuations. Manage procurement forecasting and material planning. Improve procurement systems, reporting, and purchasing controls. Coordinate material purchasing, logistics, and delivery schedules. Present monthly procurement performance reports to executive leadership.

7+ years of procurement, purchasing, sourcing, or supply chain experience. Experience within construction, glazing, architectural glass, façade systems, building envelope, metal fabrication, or related industries. Strong contract negotiation and supplier management experience. Proven track record of generating measurable cost savings. Ability to analyze pricing structures and supplier performance. Fluent English communication skills.
Highly Preferred
Existing relationships with manufacturers and distributors in the façade, glazing, curtain wall, or architectural metals sectors. Experience purchasing materials for commercial construction projects. Knowledge of Passive House, high-performance building systems, and modern façade technologies. Experience with ERP and procurement management software.
Success Metrics
Procurement Savings Cost Avoidance Supplier Reliability Lead Time Reduction Margin Improvement Forecast Accuracy Supply Chain Stability

Why Join Longarone?
Fully Remote Position Direct Access to Executive Leadership High Growth Environment Opportunity to Build a World-Class Procurement Department Performance-Based Compensation Work on Landmark Building Envelope Projects Throughout the Northeast U. S.

Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.
Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.

We work with start-ups, scale-ups and enterprise clients across different industries. - Ability to experiment with new approaches in product that incorporate AI tools, where it is appropriate - Work on projects for big global brands - Exposure to different geographies - Support and close collaboration with a cross-discipline team of Design, Product, BA and technical practitioners - Competitive salary depending on your skills and experience. - Constant development of your skills with the help of a knowledgeable product community: knowledge-sharing events and mentorship practices. - Regular support of your research leader and mentor.

title: Project manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2 B technology.
This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.
About Ten16 Creative Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3 D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.
We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.
About the Role The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.
This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.
You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.
You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.
You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.
Qualifications The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.

Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset.

Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity:
Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.

title: Business analyst
description:

Our purpose eco Portal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team's potential. Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we're committed to helping clients achieve that. Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all. Who are we? We're a true Kiwi tech success story, built from the ground up, with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it. We're anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from within—with our very own team. Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole. You can see more about our storyjourney here!
We create intuitive health and safety software that people want to use, giving businesses the visibility and data they need to prevent risks and build stronger, safer workplaces and safety cultures. Safety isn't just a department, it's a culture that involves everyone, from frontline workers to the boardroom. eco Portal makes safety simple, visible, and shared, with an intuitive interface that people actually want to use. We help create stronger engagement, fewer incidents, and measurable improvements that drive both culture and performance. The Role An exciting opportunity is available at eco Portal. We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our Project Management Office (PMO) Team, supporting the successful implementation of our Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance Saa S platform. You'll play a vital role in gathering, analysing, and finalising customer requirements, ensuring that each solution is tailored to deliver value while aligning with eco Portal's product capabilities and delivery standards. As a Business Analyst , you'll collaborate closely with Project Managers, Implementation Specialists , and customer stakeholders to design fit-for-purpose solutions—ranging from minimal changes to standard templates through to complex, bespoke configurations. You'll need strong communication, analytical, and documentation skills, and an ability to work across technical and business teams to ensure clarity, alignment, and successful delivery. Key Responsibilities Lead customer workshops and meetings to capture, validate, and finalise business requirements in line with scope. Translate customer needs into clear, technically aligned documentation using tools such as process flows, user stories, and functional specifications. Support the design of both standard and custom solutions that align with eco Portal platform capabilities. Collaborate with internal teams (Project Managers, Implementation Specialists) to ensure smooth solution delivery. Proactively identify and flag risks or misalignments early, recommending alternative solutions where appropriate. Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating builds against requirements and assisting with defect triage. Contribute to a smooth customer transition from implementation to business-as-usual (BAU) through handover documentation. Maintain a deep understanding of eco Portal's platform functionality to provide practical, value-driven guidance. Assist with continuous improvement initiatives, helping to refine our BA tools, templates, and methodologies. We're Looking for Someone Who... Has 2+ years of Business Analyst experience , ideally within Saa S or software implementation environments. Demonstrates strong requirement gathering, analysis, and solution design capabilities. Can confidently facilitate workshops and work directly with customers and internal teams to define the "what" and the "why." Is proficient in documentation practices , including process mapping, user stories, functional specs, and change logs. Understands the value of collaboration and can work fluidly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Has exposure to project delivery methodologies such as Agile or Hybrid models. Communicates clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing. Is naturally curious and detail-oriented , with a drive to understand how things work and improve them. Has experience or familiarity with Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance (HSRC) systems – a bonus, but not required! Holds relevant certifications in Business Analysis (e.g., CBAP, CCBA ) or has equivalent experience – highly desirable. Perks & Benefits: 37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team. Generous Annual Leave Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with eco Portal. End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at eco Portal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you've been with e P, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you're here. ️ Professional Development: eco Portal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training. Wellness Support: To support your mental health and overall wellbeing, we offer reimbursements for professional mental health assistance. Workplace Enjoyment: We believe in fostering a positive, engaged, and diverse team through various social activities. Enjoy virtual social events and company-wide activations with the eco Portal HQ team in NZ and our global offshore team. What now? Ready to introduce yourself? Don't be shy! We want to hear from you. Please upload your resume, cover letter, and any other information, documents and links that will help you stand out. Find out more about eco Portal visit. eco Portal is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Business Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal.3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the process.4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.G., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepancies.5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquiries.6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.G., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportunities.

title: Business Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal.3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the process.4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.G., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepancies.5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquiries.6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.G., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportunities.
